import pandas as pd, numpy as np, statsmodels.api as sm
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
exposures = ['nitrogen_ppm','phosphorus_ppm','potassium_ppm','soil_ph','irrigation_mm','seed_density','mulch_depth_cm','biochar_g','fungicide_ml','shade_pct']
d = df.dropna(subset=exposures+['yield_kg']).copy()

# simple: potassium + farm only
X = pd.get_dummies(d[['farm']], drop_first=True).astype(float)
X = pd.concat([d[['potassium_ppm']].reset_index(drop=True), X.reset_index(drop=True)], axis=1)
X = sm.add_constant(X)
m = sm.OLS(d['yield_kg'].reset_index(drop=True), X).fit()
print("potassium + farm only:")
print(m.params, m.pvalues)

# per-farm slope of potassium
for f in d['farm'].unique():
    s = d[d['farm']==f]
    mm = sm.OLS(s['yield_kg'], sm.add_constant(s[['potassium_ppm']])).fit()
    print(f, round(mm.params['potassium_ppm'],3), round(mm.pvalues['potassium_ppm'],4))

# check other exposures individually with farm
print("\nSingle-exposure + farm tests:")
for e in exposures:
    X = pd.get_dummies(d[['farm']], drop_first=True).astype(float)
    X = pd.concat([d[[e]].reset_index(drop=True), X.reset_index(drop=True)], axis=1)
    X = sm.add_constant(X)
    mm = sm.OLS(d['yield_kg'].reset_index(drop=True), X).fit()
    print(f"{e:16s} coef={mm.params[e]: .3f} p={mm.pvalues[e]:.4f}")

{"code": "import pandas as pd, numpy as np, statsmodels.api as sm
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
exposures = ['nitrogen_ppm','phosphorus_ppm','potassium_ppm','soil_ph','irrigation_mm','seed_density','mulch_depth_cm','biochar_g','fungicide_ml','shade_pct']
d = df.dropna(subset=exposures+['yield_kg']).copy()

# simple: potassium + farm only
X = pd.get_dummies(d[['farm']], drop_first=True).astype(float)
X = pd.concat([d[['potassium_ppm']].reset_index(drop=True), X.reset_index(drop=True)], axis=1)
X = sm.add_constant(X)
m = sm.OLS(d['yield_kg'].reset_index(drop=True), X).fit()
print("potassium + farm only:")
print(m.params, m.pvalues)

# per-farm slope of potassium
for f in d['farm'].unique():
    s = d[d['farm']==f]
    mm = sm.OLS(s['yield_kg'], sm.add_constant(s[['potassium_ppm']])).fit()
    print(f, round(mm.params['potassium_ppm'],3), round(mm.pvalues['potassium_ppm'],4))

# check other exposures individually with farm
print("\nSingle-exposure + farm tests:")
for e in exposures:
    X = pd.get_dummies(d[['farm']], drop_first=True).astype(float)
    X = pd.concat([d[[e]].reset_index(drop=True), X.reset_index(drop=True)], axis=1)
    X = sm.add_constant(X)
    mm = sm.OLS(d['yield_kg'].reset_index(drop=True), X).fit()
    print(f"{e:16s} coef={mm.params[e]: .3f} p={mm.pvalues[e]:.4f}")
"}
